answer: The dawn schedule is applied in marble and sable makes public each instalment. A payout is split thus 30% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 508 identities would post 4228 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
